note: The root key records the consonants of the place name. Its derivation is uncertain.
summary: Terah and his household set out from Ur for Canaan. They reached Haran and settled there.

senses.definition: The place where Terah and his household settled on their journey from Ur toward Canaan.

evidence.note: עַד חָרָן marks the point the travelers reached. שָׁם refers back to Haran as the place where they settled.
